description: This file contains utility classes and methods for serializing and deserializing calculator command and state objects to and from JSON, including aliases for commands, history items, snapshots, and the overall application state within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: CalcManagerTokenAlias
classes.description: Alias class for CalcManagerToken used for JSON serialization, with properties for OpCodeName and CommandIndex.

classes.name: ICalcManagerIExprCommandAlias
classes.description: Interface for command aliases with polymorphic JSON serialization for different command types.

classes.name: UnaryCommandAlias
classes.description: Alias for UnaryCommand, representing unary commands in JSON.

classes.name: BinaryCommandAlias
classes.description: Alias for BinaryCommand, representing binary commands in JSON.

classes.name: OperandCommandAlias
classes.description: Alias for OperandCommand, including properties for numeric attributes and commands.

classes.name: CalcManagerHistoryItemAlias
classes.description: Alias for CalcManagerHistoryItem, representing a history record with tokens, commands, expression, and result.

classes.name: CalcManagerSnapshotAlias
classes.description: Alias for CalcManagerSnapshot, representing a snapshot of calculator state including history items.

classes.name: PrimaryDisplaySnapshotAlias
classes.description: Alias for PrimaryDisplaySnapshot, representing the primary display state.

classes.name: ExpressionDisplaySnapshotAlias
classes.description: Alias for ExpressionDisplaySnapshot, representing expression tokens and commands.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorSnapshotAlias
classes.description: Alias for StandardCalculatorSnapshot, encapsulating calculator state including snapshots and commands.

classes.name: ApplicationSnapshotAlias
classes.description: Alias for ApplicationSnapshot, representing overall app state including mode and calculator snapshot.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: Static class providing mapping functions between command and token alias objects and their core representations.

methods.name: MapToken
methods.description: Converts a CalcManagerTokenAlias to a CalcManagerToken object.

methods.name: MapCommandAlias
methods.description: Converts an ICalcManagerIExprCommand to its alias form.

methods.name: MapCommandAlias
methods.description: Converts an ICalcManagerIExprCommandAlias back to its core command object.
